title: All-moduli Dirichlet nonvanishing at 0.87338196661320752
description: Proves Dirichlet nonvanishing for every positive modulus and character when Re(s) > 5458637291332547/6250000000000000, excluding only the principal pole. The reserve-parametric seed and above-half selected energy of positive-reserve-selected-gap are instantiated at smaller fixed positive gaps, giving the source G(1 - 10^-20, 2 + 10^-19, 0.15). The five count windows are kept, h is retuned, and the reserve and conductor extension fall to 10^-20, taking the return to within 7.1e-20 of the limiting contact (777 - sqrt(1081))/852 with a deeper kernel-checked edge cover. The final theorem has no analytic or source-provider premise. Builds on OpenAI, Hailey Collet, ArviFoxy, Sil and Jacob Sussman, including the PR93 selected sextic norm, PR97 selected-leaf energy and PR98 physical return. Inherited notices and licenses are retained. The development was AI-assisted.
